titel: In a Wooden Boat at Sea
drehbuch: Calm sea; the gulls circle at ease.
A skein of geese crosses in front of you; you can hear their calls for a long time.
A flock of gulls flies past along the coast as the wind rises.
The wind freshens; the sail fills more often.
The waves grow, the hull is hit harder; the gulls call more excitedly, their cries blown about by the wind.
Heavy sea: breakers crash against the rock one after another.
The wind drops and the sea settles.
Calm again – the gulls circle lazily once more.
